title: dg bot ask --json
description: A bot asked to work on a pull request or issue: the request, and the letter that hands it the thread's members-only content as it is now.

request.description: The request's event id: the job.

letter.description: The letter's packManifest document id, when members-only content was shared.

documents.description: Members-only posts the letter opens (the request itself included).

code.description: The members-only branch whose code was shared, if any.

membersOnly.description: Whether the thread is members-only (the task is then members-only too).
